identity.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
identity.repo_note: Official repository at 698ea39, with mjlab_research cloned beside it. play.py exited 2 because --wandb-path is required and the README names no run. train.py ran SuperMimic-GenCoord-G1 on an RTX 5070 Ti. The W&B motion registry needs an API key, so the motion was a 64-frame random G1 clip.

summary: One differentiable world model is fit to short windows of a MuJoCo Warp humanoid, then a tracking policy is improved by backpropagating through 32 imagined steps of that frozen model. The paper's claim is the compute cut: within 3 hours on one H100 the return passes a SONIC checkpoint that the paper accounts as 128 L40 GPUs for 168 hours. A GenCoord G1 run on an RTX 5070 Ti constructed the default MLPs and saved 18,816,634 parameters: dynamics 8,745,346, sim context 66, actor 9,839,797, critic 231,425.

landscape.paradigm: Differentiable world model and short-horizon BPTT
landscape.bottleneck: GPU scaling of model-free RL. The paper reports more than a 1000x GPU-hour cut against the cited SONIC run.
landscape.hardware_fit: Local note: ideal online RL, about 6–8 GB VRAM. The paper's reported runs use H100 80 GB.

data.note: The paper's 129,514-motion library was not downloaded. The W&B registry requires an API key. A 64-frame random G1 clip was opened so train.py could build the env. The replay-buffer schema was read from the runner. The GenCoord run measured full state 71, goal 670, action 29, and sim context 33. extracts/replay_buffer_example.json is a 27-frame rollout of the smoke-run actor on that clip.

datasets.name: Motion library
datasets.role: reference goals and the scaling benchmark
datasets.volume: Shared benchmark of 129,514 motions. The scaling sweep runs from 1 hour to 264 hours of motion.
datasets.sampling: Default runner mode is return-based reset sampling: 0.50 uniform, a softmax on negative return with steepness 25, and 0.10 on bins that have accumulated focus.
datasets.augmentation: Action noise is added in simulation so the world model sees a wider action range. Sensor noise is added outside the world model.

recorded.success_filter: Reference clips are the tracking goal. The sections used here do not filter them by task success.

golden.description: The clip supplies the tracking goal. It is not the world-model regression target.

datasets.name: Replay buffer
datasets.volume: Default buffer length 1000 steps per environment. World-model windows are 8 steps, batch 2048, 10 batches. Policy imagination uses batch 4096 and horizon 32.
datasets.sampling: New transitions replace the oldest. Imagination seeds are sampled from the buffer.
datasets.augmentation: None inside the buffer. Noise is applied at collection and again when the policy reads a predicted observation.

model.overview: Dynamics is an MLP on normalized representation-state, processed action, and sim context. It predicts an acceleration-level increment that the representation integrates. The actor is a per-task encoder to a 32-d tanh latent and a shared decoder. The critic is a smaller MLP. Defaults are in SuperMimicRunnerCfg.

model.runtime: Device cuda:0, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, torch 2.15.0+cu132. play.py SuperMimic-GenCoord-G1 exited 2 when called without a checkpoint: --wandb-path is required and the README does not name a run. train.py then ran 8 iterations with 32 envs. The first pass never called the optimizer, because the only scheduled update fired when the replay buffer held 1 frame and the world-model horizon is 8. A second pass kept horizons 8 and 32, set the world-model batch to 1x32 and the policy batch to 32, and at iteration 7 logged Loss/state 3.1136, Loss/joint_pos 0.0383, Loss/joint_vel 7.0647, Policy/reward -0.3996, Policy/value_function 0.3386. World-model step 32.0 s, policy step 151.4 s. The run printed State Dim 71, Goal Dim 670, sim context 33 (foot_friction, base_com, encoder_bias), representation full 71, rep 68, pred 35. Environment step 0.02 s. extracts/capture_example.py then loaded that actor and rolled out 27 frames on one env. The episode ended on motion_end. Each frame stores the 29-d checkpoint action and the 71-d next full state.

compute.name: Reported result run
compute.value: One H100 80 GB for 3 hours passes the released SONIC return. Two H100s for 9.8 hours reach zero failures on the 129,514-motion benchmark. SONIC is cited as 128 L40 GPUs for 168 hours.

compute.name: Code defaults
compute.value: World-model Adam lr 2e-4, 10 batches of 2048 windows of 8 steps. Policy horizon 32, batch 4096, gamma 0.99, GAE lambda 0.95, 5 epochs of 4 minibatches.

compute.name: Local smoke run
compute.value: RTX 5070 Ti, 32 envs, 8 iterations. One optimizer step with world-model batch 32 and policy batch 32. Loss/state 3.1136. Policy/reward -0.3996. The paper default is 4096 envs and world-model batch 2048.

objectives.name: World-model fit
objectives.explanation: The official loss that was opened is the state term: squared error per named channel group, weighted by Bryson's rule 1/nominal^2, then averaged by channel count. Reward, observation, and termination heads are separate. The fit rolls the MLP forward on logged actions for k=8 and does not score the last unused action.

symbols.meaning: Sim context held fixed over the window.

objectives.name: Imagined return
objectives.explanation: The world model is frozen. The actor minimizes the negative discounted return through 32 imagined steps, plus the encoder's auxiliary latent-BC loss. Survival weight c multiplies through the predicted termination probability.

symbols.meaning: Critic bootstrap at the end of the window.

objectives.name: Critic regression
objectives.explanation: Targets are GAE returns on the imagined rollout, computed once and then fit for 5 epochs of 4 minibatches. The code clamps values by the maximum discounted step reward.

train.text: Reset the MuJoCo Warp env, build the representation and the dynamics MLP from the measured state size, and open a replay buffer.
Step the current actor in simulation and append state, noisy action, motion time, termination, and sim context.
Reweight motion-bin resets from the return sampler.
Fit the world model on 8-step windows, then freeze it and take a BPTT step on 32-step imagined rollouts. Fit the critic on GAE targets from that rollout.

infer.text: Download the run's world_model.pt and actor.pt and load them.
The viewer steps the env with the actor. The dynamics module is loaded for the visualization overlay.
Deployed control uses the actor on proprioception and the goal. The paper states the world model is not required on the robot.

task.horizon: The world model is fit on windows of 8 steps. Policy improvement imagines 32 steps.
task.contact: Sim context is 33-d: foot_friction, base_com, encoder_bias. No tactile image.
task.latency: The GenCoord environment step is 0.02 s and the physics step is 0.005 s. The paper's result run is one H100 for 3 hours.
task.data: A library of 129,514 reference motions. The replay buffer stores 1,000 steps per environment.

evidence.claim: One H100 for 3 hours passes the cited SONIC return, and two H100s for 9.8 hours reach zero failures on 129,514 motions. The comparison is the full recipe, not an ablation of the MLP width.

gaps: play.py was not opened as a viewer. Without --checkpoint or --wandb-path it exits 2, and the README does not name a run. The example clip loads the local actor directly.
The W&B motion registry was not downloaded. The training step and the example clip use a 64-frame random G1 clip, so the 129,514-motion library is still unread.

The smoke run used 32 environments and batch 32. The example actor took one optimizer step. The paper's reported run is one H100 for 3 hours, and the code default is 4096 environments with world-model batch 2048.
The 6–8 GB local feasibility note is the planning label. This pass did not record peak VRAM.
